# CA Plastics Research Atlas

> A static, independent atlas of plastic-related research connected to California. It lists the researchers, institutions and works behind that research, built from public bibliographic data (OpenAlex) and public funding and monitoring sources.

Independent research atlas; profiles are generated from public bibliographic data.

## Main pages

- [Atlas home](https://plastiverse.live/california/): overview and entry points to every view
- [Plastiverse Live](https://plastiverse.live/): the global home page; regional atlases start with California
- [Explore the data](https://plastiverse.live/explore): global plastics research by country (works, trend, evidence map, authors, institutions, collaboration network, newest works), with a scope switch from the world to a continent or country
- [Authors](https://plastiverse.live/california/authors): California-connected plastics researchers
- [Collaboration network](https://plastiverse.live/california/network): who co-authors with whom
- [Institutions](https://plastiverse.live/california/institutions): institutions with California-connected plastics research; one page per institution at https://plastiverse.live/california/institution#inst=<institution ID>
- [Monitoring](https://plastiverse.live/california/monitoring): monitoring sources and samples
- [Funding](https://plastiverse.live/california/funding): grants and awards
- [Evidence map](https://plastiverse.live/california/evidence): publication and evidence views
- [Policy](https://plastiverse.live/california/policy): policy context
- [Related resources](https://plastiverse.live/california/resources): other data and tools
- [Glossary](https://plastiverse.live/california/glossary): terms used in the Atlas
- [About](https://plastiverse.live/california/about): method, scope and limitations
- [Sitemap](https://plastiverse.live/sitemap.xml): index of all static pages

## Entity pages (static, one per author or institution)

- Author profiles: https://plastiverse.live/california/experts/<OpenAlex author ID>/
- Institution profiles: https://plastiverse.live/california/institutions/<institution ID>/
